LanguageData.MV_ScheduleSettingsDescription:
Overrride the default RimWorld schedule with those specified below, with the following rules (assuming all options below are enabled):
NeverSleep | Night Shift | Biphasic | Day Shift BodyMastery/Never Sleep Gene > NightOwl > UV Sensitive > Very Sleepy > Sleepy > Low Sleep > Normal
This only modifies the pawns initial schedule upon recruitment; their schedule can always be changed afterwards in game.
LanguageData.MV_EnableBodyMasterySchedule: Assign Body Mastery pawns the Never Sleep Schedule
LanguageData.MV_EnableBodyMasteryScheduleTooltip: Assign any pawns with the Body Mastery trait the Never Sleep schedule.
LanguageData.MV_EnableNeverSleepGeneSchedule: Assign Never Sleep pawns the Never Sleep Schedule
LanguageData.MV_EnableNeverSleepGeneScheduleTooltip: Assign any pawns with the Never Sleep gene the Never Sleep schedule.
LanguageData.MV_EnableNightOwlSchedule: Assign Night Owl pawns the Night Shift Schedule
LanguageData.MV_EnableNightOwlScheduleTooltip: Assign any pawns with the Night Owl trait the Night Owl schedule.
LanguageData.MV_EnableUVSensitiveSchedule: Assign UV Sensitive pawns the Night Shift Schedule
LanguageData.MV_EnableUVSensitiveScheduleTooltip: Assign pawns with UV sensitive genes (Dirtmoles, Sanguophages, etc.) the Night Shift schedule.
LanguageData.MV_EnableSleepyGeneSchedule: Assign Sleepy Pawns the Biphasic Schedule
LanguageData.MV_EnableSleepyGeneScheduleTooltip: Assign pawns that have sleep modifying genes (Very Sleepy, Sleepy) the Biphasic schedule.
LanguageData.MV_EnableInitialScheduleTooltip: Assign any pawns that don't meet the above criteria the Day Shift schedule (note that this includes pawns with the Low Sleep gene).
